newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Technologie to reshuffle units.
newsitem.headline: VA Technologie to reshuffle units.

text.p: Engineering group VA Technologie AG said on Wednesday it would reorganise its unit structure in a bid to increase efficiency.

VA Technologie said it would combine its fully-owned Elin Energieanwendung subsidiary and its majority-owned Elektrobau AG in a new unit, to be called Elin EBG Elektrotechnik Holding GmbH. Both units are suppliers of large-scale electrical equipment.
The new company will have combined sales of around six billion schillings and a workforce of 3,000, the group said in a statement. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
